entries.rationale: The monograph's own title and imprint pages verify the existing bibliographic identity, publisher, series, date and copyrighted status and add ISBN 951-9380-40-X. The supplied file changes access from unknown to partial, but its six pages contain front matter only and do not satisfy the complete-book acquisition need.

before.title: Linguistic Peculiarities in the Aramaic Magic Bowl Texts
before.citation: Juusola, Hannu. Linguistic Peculiarities in the Aramaic Magic Bowl Texts. Studia Orientalia 86. Helsinki: Finnish Oriental Society, 1999.
before.notes: Bibliographic details and broad scope verified from Eljakim Wajsberg's complete 2001 review, SRC-D721A94FA3B2, printed p. 167. The monograph itself is not held; the supplied Project MUSE PDF is the review.

after.title: Linguistic Peculiarities in the Aramaic Magic Bowl Texts
after.citation: Juusola, Hannu. Linguistic Peculiarities in the Aramaic Magic Bowl Texts. Studia Orientalia 86. Helsinki: Finnish Oriental Society, 1999.
after.notes: A researcher-supplied six-page scan of the monograph's title page, copyright and imprint page, acknowledgements, contents, and one blank page is held privately by SHA-256 c0bd6a93857c81d8e8f67e2fbf2ffb971e8bd85e1f336b4d70a4e63ce2ee2bee. It verifies ISBN 951-9380-40-X and the existing bibliographic record. The contents run through printed page 263, but the chapters themselves are absent; the complete monograph remains unheld. Wajsberg's complete 2001 review is held separately as SRC-D721A94FA3B2. Copyright 1999 Finnish Oriental Society; no public redistribution clearance is inferred.
